title: USF-178 operator workflow provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: Windmill operator automation disposition is split by semantic requirement. Temporal application workflow proof and jobs proof may support bounded workflow posture only and are not equivalent to Windmill operator automation access, approval, privileged operation, tenant, secret, audit, retention, cleanup, or fail-closed proof.

operatorWorkflowProviderDisposition.riskStatement: Windmill service catalogue presence, Temporal application workflow proof, jobs proof, or worker runtime proof could be mistaken for operator automation access, approval, privileged operation, tenant, secret, audit, retention, cleanup, or fail-closed readiness.
operatorWorkflowProviderDisposition.treatment: USF-178 defers Windmill SDK/client/CLI/protocol selection, adapter implementation, operator automation execution, approval workflow, privileged operation boundary, tenant and secret proof, audit evidence, retention, cleanup, failure handling, timeout, retry, teardown, incident, vulnerability, privacy, supplier, and access-review proof to USF-203; USF-203 records the blocked reclassification and USF-212 owns actual bootstrap and proof work.
operatorWorkflowProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: USF-178 records the bounded disposition gate, non-equivalence boundary, runtime manifest deferral, enterprise evidence rows, validator coverage, and planted defects only; USF-203 records a separate blocked reclassification matrix.

temporalJobsSubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Temporal application workflow proof, jobs proof, and worker runtime proof are not equivalent to Windmill operator automation service semantics, operator console access, approval workflows, privileged operation execution, Windmill-specific tenant and secret boundaries, audit operation evidence, retention execution, cleanup, supplier posture, or teardown behaviour.
scopeCovered: bounded local jobs and workflow proof where semantically permitted
bounded Temporal application workflow provider proof where semantically permitted
non-equivalence to Windmill operator automation provider semantics
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove Windmill adapter binding
does not prove Windmill operator console access
does not prove approval workflow execution
does not prove privileged operation boundary
does not prove Windmill tenant or secret isolation
does not prove operator automation audit operation evidence
does not prove provider teardown or cleanup

providerBoundary.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Windmill remains a deferred operator automation provider boundary until USF-203 proves service semantics, access, approval, privileged operation, tenant and secret boundaries, audit evidence, retention, failure handling, and cleanup.
